reasoning:
I could not refute the claim, and the dependence is real.

(1) The paper relies on the companion. Input 2.1 (chordal trace) and Input 2.4 (nested whole-plane CLE) are stated in 02-inputs.tex as "standing inputs". The text calls them "precisely [FKCompanion, label chordal:trace]" and "the separately cited Theorem ... label loop:plane". They are used in Sec 5 (lines 592-607), Sec 7 (line 329) and Sec 8 (lines 392, 483). The paper offers no alternative proof. Yet Theorem 1 (01-introduction.tex:114) is stated unconditionally for every q in [1,4). Outside q=2, where FK-Ising results exist, nothing in the literature supplies these inputs. That includes q=1: convergence of square-lattice bond percolation is open.

(2) The companion step is weak. I read the bundled companion observable.tex Secs 7.2-7.4 and preliminaries.tex (Prop. exp:comparisons). The arithmetic in hol:strict-budget is internally consistent:
- exp:charge-budget, applied to the two charge sets, gives (1/2)Σ log(F-/F+) ≤ -P.
- exp:rectangle-budget with C_i ≥ 0 gives P + D* ≤ o(log n).
The sibling's real objection is a "proves too much" argument, and on inspection it holds up. The leaf cost accounting in "The complete cost of the norm diagrams" never uses the stencil: the text says "No decay from an unextracted insertion is used". It charges wrong-expansion costs (2P per s-flip pair, 2D* per t-flip pair, log F-/F+ per endpoint) only to odd-reflection copies of the marks and endpoints. Those copies exist for any reflection tree with at least one split. The baseline then cancels exactly the normalization Z_g^cap E[U T_g] of H_g (wall:H-normalized). Running the same tree on the undifferenced Ξ_g, where the probe insertions are just intact local copies at O(1) cost, would give |H_g| ≤ n^{-c0+o(1)}. Gap closure (multipliers bounded above and below) and wall factorization (a_n bounded away from 0) would then force hJ ≡ 0. That contradicts the nonconstant J used in the proof of Thm hol:disk. I found nothing in Secs 7.2-7.4 that makes the wrong-copy costs depend on the differenced stencil, so some ingredient of hol:mixed-bound must be false as stated. Without it, holomorphicity, and with it chordal:trace and loop:plane, are not established for general q.

(3) Severity. This is not a new error in this paper; it is inherited through explicitly labelled citations, and the paper's own occupation-measure arguments may well be correct given the inputs. Still, the main theorem as stated (unconditional, all q in [1,4)) is unsupported except at q=2. I rate it major for this paper, to be framed as "the result is conditional on an unverified companion theorem" rather than as a flaw in this paper's own reasoning.
